description_en: Modifies the billable method of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS实例的计费方式
name: TransformDBInstancePayType

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request and prevents duplicate requests. The client generates the value of this parameter. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the subscription duration. Valid values:
If the Period parameter is set to Year, set the value to 1 to 5.
If the Period parameter is set to Month, set the value to 1 to 11.

This parameter is required if the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11。

若PayType=Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The billing method to which the instance is changed. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例变更后的付费类型。取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the subscription type of the subscription instance. Valid values:
Year: yearly subscription
Month: monthly subscription

This parameter is required if the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若PayType=Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

This parameter takes effect only when you change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription.
Any string other than true is processed as false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭

该参数仅在按量付费转包年包月时生效。
传入的所有非true字符串均会被处理为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use vouchers to offset fees. Valid values:

true: uses vouchers.
false: does not use vouchers. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券抵扣费用，取值：

true：使用
false：不使用（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
PREPAY: subscription
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型。
按量付费：POSTPAY
包年包月：PREPAY

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The expiration time.
This parameter is not returned if the billing method is changed to pay-as-you-go
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
到期时间。
如果变更为按量付费，该参数不返回
